phases.page.title: Census 2027: Two-Phase National Architecture
phases.page.description: The 16th National Census is partitioned into two distinct operational phases. Phase 1 establishes the baseline spatial dwelling structure and household amenities, while Phase 2 captures detailed socio-economic, demographic, and caste particulars for every resident in India.
phases.timeline.title: Phase Progression & Reference Moments
phases.timeline.subtitle: Operational calendar formally notified in the Gazette of India.
phases.timeline.hloSummary: Surveys all residential, commercial, and mixed-use structures across India. Collects building condition, building materials (floor/wall/roof), dwelling rooms, drinking water, electricity, toilet types, cooking fuel (LPG), and household assets (smartphones, broadband, vehicles).
phases.timeline.peSummary: Counts every person residing in India. Captures individual demographic particulars: full name, relationship to head, sex, date of birth/age, marital status, caste enumeration (first since 1931), mother tongue, languages known, literacy, educational level, occupation, migration, and disability.

trust.page.title: Data Privacy, Legal Immunity & Misinformation Shield
trust.page.description: Census 2027 operates under the most stringent statutory privacy protections in Indian law. Learn about your constitutional rights, test viral claims with our AI fact-checker, and verify genuine field enumerators.
trust.pillars.sectionSubtitle: How Section 15 of the Census Act, 1948 bars courts, police, and commercial entities from accessing your data.
trust.pillars.sec15Desc: By statutory mandate under Section 15 of the Census Act, 1948, no person has the right to inspect any census book or register. Individual census records are strictly inadmissible as evidence in any civil, criminal, or revenue court.
trust.pillars.firewallDesc: Census data is compiled strictly in aggregated, anonymized macro-demographic tables. It cannot be cross-referenced, transferred to, or queried by Income Tax, Police, Intelligence, or private commercial databases.
trust.pillars.penalDesc: Section 11 of the Census Act prescribes severe criminal penalties, fines, and imprisonment for any census officer or enumerator who unlawfully discloses or misuses confidential citizen responses.
trust.pillars.zeroServerDesc: The Jan Ganana self-enumeration architecture utilizes client-side isolated memory for drafts. Your answers generate a local cryptographic QR token and are never uploaded to centralized servers without explicit authorized handshake.
trust.pillars.statuteTitle: Statutory Text of Section 15, The Census Act 1948
trust.pillars.statuteQuote: “Records of census not open to inspection nor admissible in evidence: No person shall have a right to inspect any book, register or record made by a census-officer in the discharge of his duty as such, or any schedule delivered under section 10, and notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the Indian Evidence Act, 1872, no entry in any such book, register, record or schedule shall be admissible as evidence in any civil proceeding whatsoever or in any criminal proceeding...”
trust.pillars.statuteCitation: — The Census Act, 1948 (Act No. 37 of 1948), Gazette of India

trust.impostor.sectionSubtitle: Verify official badges and avoid fraudulent impostors during the door-to-door enumeration phase.
trust.impostor.boxTitle: Field Enumerator Verification Checklist & ID Checker
trust.impostor.boxSubtitle: Know your rights and verify visiting field officers to protect your family against impostors and financial fraud.
trust.impostor.check1Desc: Every enumerator carries a government-issued identity card with an official hologram and scannable verification QR code.
trust.impostor.check2Desc: Data collection is conducted strictly on the certified Census of India mobile app without third-party tools.
trust.impostor.check3Desc: A genuine enumerator NEVER asks for bank accounts, ATM cards, UPI PINs, income tax statements, or OTPs.
trust.impostor.check4Desc: Census enumeration is 100% free of charge. Anyone soliciting money or 'registration fees' is an impostor.
trust.impostor.verifierSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit Enumerator Badge Number printed on the visiting officer's photo identity card (e.g. try '202714').
trust.impostor.invalidBody: Badge number not found in active official registry. Do not share household data. Contact Census Helpline: 1800-11-2027.
